instruction: Find information about scheduling a DMV appointment in Virginia

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate from Virginia DMV homepage to the appointment scheduling page. Evaluator checks if the final URL matches the expected pattern for appointments or online appointment services. Uses existing getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) and metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to find appointment scheduling information
Getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) can successfully extract the active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) properly performs regex matching against the URL
Expected URL pattern is semantically correct and covers valid appointment page paths (/appointments and /online-services/appointment)
Regex pattern correctly handles optional 'www.' subdomain
No postconfig needed - URL verification can occur after task completion
Evaluation logic is sound and will correctly determine task success/failure
Complete coverage of instruction requirements - verifies user navigated to appointment information page
